gaps.sentence: We've decided to do ___ a holiday this year.
gaps.explanation: do without = manage without having something.

gaps.sentence: I fell ___ with my best friend over a silly remark.
gaps.explanation: fall out (with somebody) = have an argument and stop being friendly.

gaps.sentence: Lawyers are drawing ___ the contract now.
gaps.explanation: draw up = prepare and write (a contract, list, plan).

gaps.sentence: The deal fell ___ at the last minute.
gaps.explanation: fall through = (a plan/deal) fail to happen.

gaps.sentence: You go ahead; I'll catch ___ with you later.
gaps.explanation: catch up (with) = reach the same point/level as somebody.

gaps.sentence: I've mixed ___ the twins' names again.
gaps.explanation: mix up = confuse one thing/person with another.

gaps.sentence: We need to iron ___ a few details before signing.
